definitions.explanation: Physically straight or unblended. Used for hair (straight hair), drinks (undiluted), and fastball pitches in baseball.
Expressing feelings or opinions directly without beating around the bush. Describes a straightforward communication style.

notes:
From English "straight." Used as both a na-adjective (ストレートな⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧) and an adverb with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (ストレート⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧). Also functions as a noun in specific contexts like baseball (ストレート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧) and drinks (ストレートで).

In baseball, ストレート is the standard term for a fastball.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ストレート⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ — to say directly
- ストレートな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ — a straightforward personality
- ストレート⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ — to drink (liquor) straight/neat
- ストレートヘア — straight hair
